results.question: What exact learning rate, number of warmup steps, and Adam optimizer beta values were used in the primary pre-training run described in Section 4?
results.expected: Learning rate 3e-4 (0.0003), 4,000 linear warmup steps, Adam optimizer beta_1 = 0.9, beta_2 = 0.95 (Section 4.2, Page 16)
results.actual_answer: During the primary pre-training run, the model used a peak learning rate of 3e-4 (0.0003), exactly 4,000 linear warmup steps, and Adam optimizer beta values of beta_1 = 0.9 and beta_2 = 0.95.

By what percentage did the proposed hybrid retrieval architecture improve Exact Match (EM) accuracy on the benchmark dataset compared with the dense-only baseline?
results.actual_answer: The proposed hybrid retrieval architecture improved Exact Match (EM) accuracy on the multi-hop benchmark dataset by 14.6% (increasing EM accuracy from 61.2% on the dense-only baseline to 75.8%).

results.question: What GPU cluster configuration (number and model of GPUs) and total training duration, in days, were required to train the 13-billion-parameter model?
results.expected: 128 NVIDIA H100 (80GB SXM5) GPUs and 18.5 days total training duration (Section 7.1, Page 45)
results.actual_answer: Training the 13-billion-parameter foundation model required a hardware cluster of 128 NVIDIA H100 (80GB SXM5) GPUs and a total training duration of 18.5 days.
